question.worked_solution:
First, we apply the power of quotient rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}{(\frac{3}{4x})}^{2}{(\frac{-2x}{5})}^{3}=\frac{{3}^{2}}{(4x)^{2}}\cdot \frac{(-2x)^{3}}{{5}^{3}}\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we apply the power of product rule and multiply:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{{3}^{2}}{(4x)^{2}}\cdot \frac{(-2x)^{3}}{{5}^{3}} & = \\ \frac{{3}^{2}}{{4}^{2}{x}^{2}}\cdot \frac{(-2)^{3}{x}^{3}}{{5}^{3}} & = \\ \frac{9}{16{x}^{2}}\cdot \frac{-8{x}^{3}}{125} & = \\ \frac{-8\cdot 9{x}^{3}}{16\cdot 125{x}^{2}}\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we apply the quotient rule and simplify:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{-8\cdot 9{x}^{3}}{16\cdot 125{x}^{2}} & = \\ -\frac{9{x}^{3-2}}{2\cdot 125} & = \\ -\frac{9x}{250}\end{aligned}
$$
